notes.title: Broken Sky Update: 14/06/2021
notes.notes:
The all new update for Broken Sky includes the following:

[list]
[*] Improved Nuke Special Weapon.
[*] Improved AfterBurner.
[*] Improved Laser Special Weapon.
[*] Changes to the bunker.
[*] More helpful information for new players.
[*] First plane is now slightly faster (only slightly, you probably won't notice!).
[*] Changes to UI to make updates/plane changes etc more obvious.
[*] Some small changes to enemies.
[*] When hit you're invincible for a little longer.
[*] Extra hints and tips.
[*] Some extra sound effects.
[*] Some small bug fixes.
[/list]

Enjoy!
